quotes.quote: Points add up to Star Money that you can use to purchase merchandise at Macy’s, Macy’s Backstage, or macys.com.
To earn additional rewards, purchases must be made at department stores included on our list of “select major department stores” that accept the Card
Kohl's, Lord & Taylor, Macy's, Neiman Marcus, Nordstrom, Saks Fifth Avenue, Sears and Stein Mart. Eligible purchases include those made in store and online.
